the process runs. Protocol: `templates/ic-process.md` (v1.1).

## S2 · THE CASE — <date>

### Bull case, steelmanned

### Concessions log [written AT THE MOMENT each is made]

| # | who conceded | what | round |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | | | |

> Concessions are recorded live so they cannot quietly un-concede by
> S3. If the S3 memo re-argues a conceded point, that is a process
> failure, not a change of mind.

### Bear case, steelmanned

### CRUXES — where we actually disagree, and what would settle it

| # | the question | my position | Casey's | evidence that would settle it |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | | | | |

### ASK list sent to sponsor — <date sent>

| # | ask | sent | answered | age (days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | | | | |

> 60 days unanswered = closed as refused, and priced as a negative
> signal. An ask ignored for two months has been answered.

**Did we agree too early?** ☐ yes → swapped sides and reran  ☐ no
